title.zh: 卷八十一 晉書7: 少帝本紀一
title.en: Volume 81 Book of Later Jin 7: Emperor Shao 1
title.raw: 卷八十一 晉書7: 少帝本紀一 Volume 81 Book of Later Jin 7: Emperor Shao 1

sentences.zh: 少帝，名重貴，高祖之從子也。

translations.literal: The Young Emperor, named Chonggui, was Gaozu's nephew.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shao, personal name Chonggui, was Gaozu's nephew.

sentences.zh: 考諱敬儒，母安氏，以唐天祐十一年六月二十七日生帝於太原汾陽裏。

translations.literal: His father's taboo name was Jingru; his mother was the An clan. On the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month in the eleventh year of Tang Tianyou, the emperor was born at Fenyang Lane in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His father bore the taboo name Jingru; his mother was Lady An. On the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month of Tianyou 11 of Tang, the emperor was born in Fenyang Lane, Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 敬儒嘗為後唐莊宗騎將，早薨，高祖以帝為子。

translations.literal: Jingru had once been a cavalry officer under Later Tang's Zhuangzong; he died young. Gaozu took the emperor as his own son.
translations.idiomatic: Jingru had once served as a cavalry officer under Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong; he died young, and Gaozu adopted the emperor as his son.

sentences.zh: 帝少而謹厚，高祖愛之。

translations.literal: The emperor from youth was prudent and steadfast; Gaozu loved him.
translations.idiomatic: From youth the emperor was prudent and steadfast, and Gaozu cherished him.

sentences.zh: 洎歷方鎮，嘗遣從行，委以庶事，但性好馳射，有祖禰之風。

translations.literal: Once he held regional commands, [Gaozu] would send him along on journeys and entrust him with routine affairs, but his nature loved galloping and archery and bore the manner of his forefathers.
translations.idiomatic: Once he held a frontier command, Gaozu would take him along on his travels and entrust him with day-to-day affairs, yet he loved riding hard and shooting from the saddle and had the bearing of his ancestors.

sentences.zh: 高祖鎮太原，命瑯琊王震以《禮記》教帝，不能領其大義，謂震曰：「非我家事業也。

translations.literal: When Gaozu was stationed at Taiyuan, he ordered Wang Zhen, Prince of Langya, to teach the emperor with the Book of Rites. [The emperor] could not grasp its larger meaning and said to Wang, "This is not my family's calling."
translations.idiomatic: While Gaozu held Taiyuan, he had Wang Zhen, Prince of Langya, instruct the emperor in the Book of Rites. The emperor could not grasp its larger meaning and told Wang, "This is not my family's calling."

sentences.zh: 」及高祖受圍於太原，親冒矢石，數獻可於左右，高祖愈重焉。

translations.literal: When Gaozu was besieged at Taiyuan, [the emperor] personally braved arrow and stone and repeatedly offered suggestions at his side; Gaozu valued him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu was besieged at Taiyuan, the emperor personally braved arrow and stone, repeatedly offered counsel at his side, and Gaozu came to esteem him all the more.

sentences.zh: 高祖受契丹冊，將入洛，欲留一子撫晉陽，先謀於戎王，戎王曰：「使諸子盡出，吾當擇之。

translations.literal: When Gaozu received the Khitan investiture and was about to enter Luoyang, wishing to leave one son to pacify Jinyang, he first consulted Prince Rong. Prince Rong said, "Have all the sons come out; I shall choose among them."
translations.idiomatic: After Gaozu received the Khitan investiture and was about to enter Luoyang, he wished to leave one son to hold Jinyang and first consulted Prince Rong. Prince Rong said, "Bring all your sons out; I will choose among them."

sentences.zh: 」乃於行中指帝謂高祖曰：「此眼大者可矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon, pointing on the march at the emperor, he said to Gaozu, "This big-eyed one will do."
translations.idiomatic: Then, pointing at the emperor on the march, he told Gaozu, "This big-eyed one will do."

sentences.zh: 」遂以帝為北京留守，授金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒，行太原尹，知河東管內節度觀察事。

translations.literal: He was then made regent of the Northern Capital, invested as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Belt and Grandee Secretary, acting Taiyuan intendant, with charge of Hedong circuit military-civil oversight.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then appointed regent of the Northern Capital, invested as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Belt and Grandee Secretary, acting as Taiyuan intendant, with authority over Hedong's military and civil administration.

sentences.zh: 天福二年九月，征赴闕，授光祿大夫、檢校太保、右金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of Tianfu 2, he was summoned to court and invested as Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Grand Guardian, and General-in-Chief of the Right Golden Griffin Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Tianfu 2 he was summoned to court and appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Grand Guardian, and General-in-Chief of the Right Golden Griffin Guard.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月，授開封尹，加檢校太傅，封鄭王，增食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of year 3, he was made Kaifeng intendant, added as Grand Preceptor, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, with an increase of three thousand households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 3 he was made Kaifeng intendant, promoted to Grand Preceptor, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, and granted an additional three thousand fief households.

sentences.zh: 俄加檢校太尉、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was added as Grand Marshal and made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was promoted to Grand Marshal and appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六年，高祖幸鄴，改廣晉尹，進封齊王。

translations.literal: In year 6, when Gaozu visited Ye, [the emperor] was changed to Guangjin intendant and advanced to Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, when Gaozu visited Ye, the emperor was reassigned as Guangjin intendant and advanced to Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: （以下疑脫「七年正月，加兼侍中」八字。）〉

translations.literal: (Below, eight characters are suspected to be missing: "In the first month of the seventh year, added concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat.")
translations.idiomatic: (The following eight characters are thought to be missing: "In the first month of the seventh year, added concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat.")

sentences.zh: 是歲六月十三日乙丑，高祖崩，承遺制命柩前即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the sixth month of that year, yichou, Gaozu died. [The emperor] received the testamentary command and took the throne before the bier.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day of the sixth month that year, yichou, Gaozu died. Following the testamentary command, the emperor took the throne before the bier.

sentences.zh: 帝在并州未著人望，及保釐浚郊，大有寬裕之稱。

translations.literal: The emperor at Bingzhou had not yet won men's regard; once he secured the realm and dredged the suburbs, he won great praise for magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: While at Bingzhou the emperor had not yet won much regard, but once he secured the realm and undertook suburban works, he gained wide praise for magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 從幸鄴都，是歲遇旱，高祖遣祈雨於白龍潭，有白龍見於潭心，是夜澍雨尺餘，人皆異之，至是果登大位焉。

translations.literal: Accompanying [Gaozu] on a visit to the Ye capital, that year there was drought. Gaozu sent [someone] to pray for rain at White Dragon Pool; a white dragon appeared in the pool's center. That night timely rain fell more than a foot; all regarded it as strange—and now he indeed ascended the great throne.
translations.idiomatic: Accompanying Gaozu on a visit to Ye, that year brought drought. Gaozu sent prayers for rain at White Dragon Pool, and a white dragon appeared at the pool's center. That night more than a foot of rain fell; everyone marveled—and now he had indeed ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜侍衛諸軍將校錢一百貫下至五貫，以初即位示賫也。

translations.literal: On dingmao, he bestowed on the officers of the various palace guard armies cash from one hundred strings down to five strings, as a display of bounty on first accession.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he bestowed on the officers of the palace guard armies sums from one hundred strings of cash down to five, as an inaugural display of bounty.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宰臣馮道等率百僚請聽政，凡三上表，允之。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the chief ministers Feng Dao and others led the hundred officials in requesting that he hear government; they submitted three memorials in all, and he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the chief ministers Feng Dao and others led the hundred officials in petitioning him to take up government; after three memorials he assented.

sentences.zh: 庚午，始聽政於崇德殿門偏廊，分命廷臣以嗣位奏告天地宗廟社稷。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he first heard government in the side corridor of Chongde Hall's gate, and separately ordered court ministers to report his succession to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he first held court in the side corridor of Chongde Hall's gate and dispatched court ministers to announce his succession to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 遣右驍衛將軍石德超等押先皇御馬二匹，往相州西山撲祭，用北俗禮也。

translations.literal: He sent Right Valiant Cavalry General Shi Dechao and others escorting two of the late emperor's imperial horses to perform the bow-and-arrow sacrifice at West Mountain in Xiangzhou—using northern custom.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Right Valiant Cavalry General Shi Dechao and others with two of the late emperor's imperial horses to perform the bow-and-arrow sacrifice at West Mountain in Xiangzhou, following northern custom.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以司徒、兼侍中馮道為大行皇帝山陵使，門下侍郎竇貞固副之，太常卿崔棁為禮儀使，戶部侍郎呂琦為鹵簿使，御史中丞王易簡為儀仗使。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he appointed Grandee Secretary and concurrent Vice Director Feng Dao as commissioner for the late emperor's mausoleum, with Vice Director of the Chancellery Dou Zhengu as deputy; Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Cui Zhi as ritual commissioner; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi as escort commissioner; and Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian as ceremonial guard commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he appointed Grandee Secretary and concurrent Vice Director Feng Dao commissioner for the late emperor's mausoleum, with Vice Director of the Chancellery Dou Zhengu as deputy; Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director Cui Zhi as ritual commissioner; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi as escort commissioner; and Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian as ceremonial guard commissioner.

sentences.zh: （徐無黨《五代史記註》云：舊史實錄無橋道頓遞使，疑不置或闕書，漢高祖亦然。）〉

translations.literal: (Xu Wudang's Notes to the History of the Five Dynasties states: The Old History's veritable record has no bridge-road relay commissioner; it is suspected the office was not established or the entry omitted; Han Gaozu was the same.)
translations.idiomatic: (Xu Wudang's Notes to the History of the Five Dynasties observes: The Old History's veritable record lists no bridge-road relay commissioner; the post may never have been created or the entry omitted; the same holds for Han Gaozu.)

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣判四方館事朱崇節、右金吾大將軍梁言持國信物使於契丹。

translations.literal: On jimao, he sent Director of the Four Directions Bureau Zhu Chongjie and Right Golden Griffin Grand General Liang Yan as envoys bearing state gifts to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he sent Zhu Chongjie, overseer of the Four Directions Bureau, and Right Golden Griffin Grand General Liang Yan as envoys bearing state gifts to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 是時，河南、河北、關西並奏蝗害稼。

translations.literal: At this time Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi all reported locusts harming the crops.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi all reported locust damage to the crops.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未朔，百官素服臨於天清殿。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day guiwei, the hundred officials in plain dress attended at Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day guiwei, the hundred officials in mourning dress attended at Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔應宮殿、州縣及官名、府號、人姓名，與先帝諱同音者改之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict ordered that palace halls, prefectures and districts, office titles, bureau names, and personal names homophonous with the late emperor's taboo name be changed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi an edict ordered that palace halls, prefectures and districts, office titles, bureau names, and personal names homophonous with the late emperor's taboo name be changed.

sentences.zh: 改西京明堂殿為宣德殿，中書政事堂為政事廳，堂後官房頭為錄事，余為主事。

translations.literal: The Western Capital's Hall of Bright Hall was changed to Hall of Proclaiming Virtue; the Secretariat's Hall of Government Affairs to Government Affairs Chamber; the chief clerk behind the hall to Recorder; the rest to Section Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital's Hall of Bright Hall was renamed Hall of Proclaiming Virtue; the Secretariat's Hall of Government Affairs became the Government Affairs Chamber; the chief clerk behind the hall became Recorder; the rest became Section Chiefs.

sentences.zh: （《東都事略·陶穀傳》：穀本姓唐，避晉祖諱改姓陶，蓋當時避諱之體如此。）〉

translations.literal: (Eastern Capital Epitome, Biography of Tao Gu: Gu's original surname was Tang; to avoid the Jin founder's taboo he changed his surname to Tao—such was the form of taboo avoidance at the time.)
translations.idiomatic: (Eastern Capital Epitome, Biography of Tao Gu: Gu was originally surnamed Tang; to avoid the Jin founder's taboo he took the surname Tao—such was taboo avoidance in that age.)

sentences.zh: 己丑，大行皇帝大祥，帝釋缞服，百官衣縿。

translations.literal: On jichou, the late emperor's second anniversary of death; the emperor removed his hemp mourning, and the hundred officials wore fine hemp.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou came the late emperor's second anniversary of death; the emperor laid aside his coarse hemp mourning, and the hundred officials wore fine hemp.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，帝除禫服，百官吉服。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the emperor removed his mourning cap and the hundred officials wore auspicious dress.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor ended his mourning cap and the hundred officials wore formal dress.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太皇太后劉氏崩，高祖之庶母也。

translations.literal: On renchen, Grand Empress Dowager Lady Liu died—she was Gaozu's concubine mother.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Grand Empress Dowager Lady Liu died; she was Gaozu's concubine mother.

sentences.zh: 遺詔服紀園陵毋用後禮，皇帝不得廢軍國機務。

translations.literal: Her testament ordered that mourning observances and mausoleum rites not use empress rites, and that the emperor not suspend military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Her testament directed that mourning and mausoleum rites not follow empress protocol and that the emperor not suspend military and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 既而禮官奏：「準令式，為祖父母齊缞周；

translations.literal: Thereupon the ritual officials memorialized: "According to regulations, for grandparents one wears equal mourning for one year;
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the ritual officials memorialized: "Under the regulations, mourning for grandparents is equal-grade hemp for one year;

sentences.zh: 又準喪葬令，皇帝本服周者，三哭而止。

translations.literal: and again according to the mourning and burial code, when the emperor's proper mourning is one year, he stops after three cries."
translations.idiomatic: and under the mourning code, when the emperor's proper mourning is one year, he stops after three cries."

sentences.zh: 請準後唐同光三年，皇太妃北京薨，莊宗於洛京西內發哀素服，不視事三日。

translations.literal: We request following Later Tang Tongguang 3, when the imperial consort mother died at the Northern Capital and Zhuangzong mourned in plain dress in Luoyang's western inner palace and did not handle affairs for three days."
translations.idiomatic: We ask to follow Later Tang in Tongguang 3, when the imperial consort mother died at the Northern Capital and Emperor Zhuangzong mourned in plain dress in Luoyang's western inner palace without handling affairs for three days."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " [The request] was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 仍遣國子祭酒兼戶部侍郎田敏奏告高祖靈座。

translations.literal: He also sent Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue Tian Min to report at Gaozu's spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue Tian Min to announce the matter at Gaozu's spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，右諫議大夫鄭受益、中書舍人楊昭儉並停見任，以請假在外，不赴國喪故也。

translations.literal: On guisi, Right Remonstrance Grandee Zheng Shouyi and Secretariat Drafter Yang Zhaojian were both suspended from their current posts for being on leave outside [the capital] and not attending the state mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Right Remonstrance Grandee Zheng Shouyi and Secretariat Drafter Yang Zhaojian were both removed from office for being on leave away from the capital and failing to attend the state mourning.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宰臣馮道等率文武百僚詣崇德殿門拜表，請禦正殿，凡三上表，允之。

translations.literal: On dingyou, chief ministers Feng Dao and others led the civil and military hundred officials to Chongde Hall's gate to bow with a memorial requesting he hold court in the main hall; they submitted three memorials in all, and he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou chief ministers Feng Dao and others led the civil and military officials to Chongde Hall's gate with a memorial asking him to hold court in the main hall; after three submissions he assented.

sentences.zh: 安州奏，水平地深七尺。

translations.literal: Anzhou reported that standing water on level ground was seven feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: Anzhou reported standing water seven feet deep on level ground.

sentences.zh: 庚子，帝御正殿，宣制：「大赦天下，諸道州府各色罪犯，除十惡五逆、殺人強盜、官典犯贓、合作毒藥、屠牛鑄錢外，其餘罪犯，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the emperor held court in the main hall and proclaimed: "A great amnesty for all under Heaven. Criminals of every kind in the circuits and prefectures—except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, murder, robbery, official embezzlement, compounding poison, slaughtering cattle, and counterfeiting coin—all other crimes are pardoned and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor held court in the main hall and proclaimed: "A general amnesty for all under Heaven. For criminals of every kind in the circuits and prefectures—except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, murder, robbery, official embezzlement, compounding poison, slaughtering cattle, and counterfeiting coin—all other offenses are pardoned and remitted.

sentences.zh: 襄州安從進如能果決輸誠，並從釋放。

translations.literal: If An Congjin of Xiangzhou can decisively submit his allegiance, he too is to be released."
translations.idiomatic: If An Congjin of Xiangzhou can decisively submit his allegiance, he too shall be released."

sentences.zh: 其中外臣僚將校，並與加恩。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials and officers within and without are all to receive added favor.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials and officers at court and in the field shall all receive added favor.

sentences.zh: 天下有蟲蝗處，並與除放租稅。

translations.literal: Wherever locusts appear under Heaven, rents and taxes are remitted."
translations.idiomatic: Wherever locusts have struck, rents and taxes shall be remitted."

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，恒州順國軍節度使杜威、河東節度使劉知遠，並加檢校太師，仍增爵邑。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Shunguo Army military commissioner of Hengzhou Du Wei and Hedong military commissioner Liu Zhiyuan were both added as Grand Preceptors, with increased noble fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Du Wei, military commissioner of the Shunguo Army at Hengzhou, and Liu Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Hedong, were both promoted to Grand Preceptor with enlarged noble fiefs.

sentences.zh: 青州平盧軍節度使楊光遠加守太師。

translations.literal: Pinglu Army military commissioner of Qingzhou Yang Guangyuan was added as Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangyuan, military commissioner of the Pinglu Army at Qingzhou, was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，鄆州天平軍節度使兼侍衛馬步都虞候景延廣加特進、同中書門下平章事，充侍衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Tianping Army military commissioner of Yanzhou and Palace Guard cavalry-infantry chief inspector Jing Yanguang was made specially advanced and Associate Grand Councilor, and appointed overall commander of the palace guard personal armies.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Jing Yanguang, military commissioner of the Tianping Army at Yanzhou and chief inspector of the palace guard horse and foot, was made specially advanced and Associate Grand Councilor and appointed overall commander of the palace guard personal armies.

sentences.zh: 滑州義成軍節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞，相州彰德軍節度使、侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹，並加檢校太傅，仍增爵邑。

translations.literal: Yicheng Army military commissioner of Huazhou and palace guard cavalry commander Li Shouzhen, and Zhangde Army military commissioner of Xiangzhou and palace guard infantry commander Guo Jin, were both added as Grand Preceptors with increased noble fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen, military commissioner of the Yicheng Army at Huazhou and commander of the palace guard cavalry, and Guo Jin, military commissioner of the Zhangde Army at Xiangzhou and commander of the palace guard infantry, were both promoted to Grand Preceptor with enlarged noble fiefs.

sentences.zh: 宰臣馮道等上表，請依舊置樞密使，略曰：「竊以樞密使創自前朝，置諸近侍，其來已久，所便尤多。

translations.literal: Chief ministers Feng Dao and others submitted a memorial requesting restoration of the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, in brief: "We note that the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner was created in the previous dynasty and placed among close attendants; it has long existed and offers many conveniences.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers Feng Dao and others memorialized to restore the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, writing in brief: "The Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner was created in the previous dynasty and placed among close attendants; the office is long established and offers many conveniences.

sentences.zh: 頃歲樞密使劉處讓偶屬家艱，爰拘喪制，既從罷免，暫議改更，不曾顯降敕文，永停使額。

translations.literal: In recent years Commissioner Liu Churang happened to suffer a family bereavement and was bound by mourning regulations; once he was removed, a temporary change was discussed, but no explicit edict was ever issued permanently abolishing the commission.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years Commissioner Liu Churang happened to suffer a family bereavement and was bound by mourning regulations; once he was removed, a temporary change was discussed, yet no explicit edict ever permanently abolished the commission.

sentences.zh: 所願各歸職分，豈敢茍避繁難。

translations.literal: What we wish is that each return to his proper duty; how could we shirk difficulty out of mere convenience?
translations.idiomatic: We wish only that each return to his proper duty; we would not shirk difficulty for mere convenience.

sentences.zh: 伏請依舊置樞密使。

translations.literal: We humbly request that the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner be restored as before."
translations.idiomatic: We humbly ask that the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner be restored as before."

sentences.zh: 」初，高祖事後唐明宗，睹樞密使安重誨秉政擅權，賞罰由己，常惡之，及登極，故斷意廢罷，一委中書。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Gaozu served Later Tang's Mingzong, he saw Bureau commissioner An Chonghui hold government and monopolize power, rewards and punishments following his own will, and often hated this. On ascending the throne he therefore resolved to abolish the office and entrust everything to the Secretariat alone.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while Gaozu served Later Tang's Emperor Mingzong, he had seen Bureau commissioner An Chonghui monopolize government and power, with rewards and punishments at his own whim, and he had long resented it. On taking the throne he therefore resolved to abolish the office and entrust everything to the Secretariat alone.

sentences.zh: 至是馮道等厭其事繁，故復請置之，庶分其權。

translations.literal: Now Feng Dao and others were weary of the burden of affairs and therefore again requested its establishment, hoping to divide the power.
translations.idiomatic: Now Feng Dao and others were weary of the burden of affairs and again requested its restoration, hoping to divide the power.

sentences.zh: 表凡三上，不允。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted three times in all; it was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted three times; it was not approved.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，徐州節度使李從溫、宋州節度使安彥威並加兼中書令，西都留守、充襄州行營都部署高行周加兼侍中，鳳翔節度使李從嚴加守太保。

translations.literal: On yisi, Xuzhou military commissioner Li Congwen and Songzhou military commissioner An Yanwei were both added as concurrent Grand Councilors; Western Capital regent and Xiangzhou campaign overall commander Gao Xingzhou was added as concurrent Vice Director; Fengxiang military commissioner Li Congyan was added as Acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Congwen, military commissioner of Xuzhou, and An Yanwei, military commissioner of Songzhou, were both made concurrent Grand Councilor; Gao Xingzhou, Western Capital regent and overall commander of the Xiangzhou campaign, was made concurrent Vice Director; and Li Congyan, military commissioner of Fengxiang, was promoted to Acting Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 遣中使就中書賜宰臣馮道生辰器幣，道以幼屬亂離，早喪父母，不記生日，堅辭不受。

translations.literal: He sent a palace envoy to the Secretariat to bestow birthday vessels and silks on chief minister Feng Dao. Dao, having from youth belonged to times of turmoil and lost his parents early, did not remember his birthday and firmly declined to accept.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a palace envoy to the Secretariat to bestow birthday gifts on chief minister Feng Dao. Dao, having grown up amid turmoil and lost his parents early, did not know his birthday and firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以給事中羅周嶽為左散騎常侍，以右諫議大夫符蒙為給事中，以秘書少監兼廣晉少尹邊蔚為右散騎常侍，以廣晉少尹張煦為右諫議大夫，以廣晉府判官、光祿少卿邊光範為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Supervising Secretary Luo Zhouyue was made Left Regular Attendant; Right Remonstrance Grandee Fu Meng was made Supervising Secretary; Junior Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Guangjin vice intendant Bian Wei was made Right Regular Attendant; Guangjin vice intendant Zhang Xu was made Right Remonstrance Grandee; Guangjin bureau judge and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Bian Guangfan was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Supervising Secretary Luo Zhouyue was appointed Left Regular Attendant; Right Remonstrance Grandee Fu Meng became Supervising Secretary; Junior Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Guangjin vice intendant Bian Wei became Right Regular Attendant; Guangjin vice intendant Zhang Xu became Right Remonstrance Grandee; and Guangjin bureau judge and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Bian Guangfan became Right Remonstrance Grandee.

sentences.zh: 丁未，荊南節度使、南平王高從誨加兼尚書令，湖南節度使、楚王馬希範加守太傅。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Jingnan military commissioner and Prince of Nanping Gao Conghui was added as concurrent Director of the Masters of Writing; Hunan military commissioner and Prince of Chu Ma Xifan was added as Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Gao Conghui, military commissioner of Jingnan and Prince of Nanping, was made concurrent Director of the Masters of Writing; Ma Xifan, military commissioner of Hunan and Prince of Chu, was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 自是藩侯郡守，皆第加官封，示溥恩也。

translations.literal: From this time frontier lords and prefectural governors were all promoted in rank and enfeoffment in succession, displaying broad favor.
translations.idiomatic: From this time frontier lords and prefectural governors were promoted in rank and enfeoffment in turn, displaying broad favor.

sentences.zh: 是月，州郡十七蝗。

translations.literal: That month, seventeen prefectures and districts reported locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month seventeen prefectures and districts reported locusts.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子朔，百官素服臨於天清殿。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day renzi, the hundred officials in plain dress attended at Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the first day renzi, the hundred officials in mourning dress attended at Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以左散騎常侍羅周嶽為東京副留守。

translations.literal: On yimao, Left Regular Attendant Luo Zhouyue was made Eastern Capital deputy regent.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Left Regular Attendant Luo Zhouyue was appointed deputy regent of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以山陵禮儀使、太常卿崔棁為太子賓客，分司西都，病故也。

translations.literal: On gengshen, mausoleum ritual commissioner and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Cui Zhi was made Crown Prince's Mentor with duty at the Western Capital—he had died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen mausoleum ritual commissioner and Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director Cui Zhi was posthumously named Crown Prince's Mentor with duty at the Western Capital; he had died of illness.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，晉昌軍節度使桑維翰加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On renxu, Jinchang Army military commissioner Sang Weihan was added as Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Sang Weihan, military commissioner of the Jinchang Army, was promoted to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，宰臣馮道加守太尉，趙瑩加中書令，李崧加左僕射兼門下侍郎，和凝加右僕射。

translations.literal: On jiazi, chief minister Feng Dao was added as Acting Grand Marshal; Zhao Ying as Grand Councilor; Li Song as Left Vice Director and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; He Ning as Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi chief minister Feng Dao was promoted to Acting Grand Marshal; Zhao Ying to Grand Councilor; Li Song to Left Vice Director and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; and He Ning to Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使致慰禮馬二十匹及羅絹等物。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys with condolence gifts of twenty horses and silks and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan sent envoys with condolence gifts of twenty horses, silks, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 是日，襄州行營都部署高行周奏，收復襄州，安從進自焚而死，生擒男宏贊斬之。

translations.literal: That day, Xiangzhou campaign overall commander Gao Xingzhou reported recovery of Xiangzhou; An Congjin burned himself to death; his son Hongzan was captured alive and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: That day Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the Xiangzhou campaign, reported the recovery of Xiangzhou; An Congjin burned himself to death; his son Hongzan was captured alive and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 前河東節度使康福卒，贈太師，謚曰武安。

translations.literal: Former Hedong military commissioner Kang Fu died; he was posthumously given Grand Preceptor and the posthumous title Martial Pacifier.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hedong military commissioner Kang Fu died; he was posthumously named Grand Preceptor with the posthumous title Martial Pacifier.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以太子太保兼尚書左僕射劉句為太子太傅。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Crown Prince's Guardian and concurrent Left Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Gou was made Crown Prince's Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Liu Gou, Crown Prince's Guardian and concurrent Left Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Crown Prince's Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 詔賜襄州城內百姓粟，大戶二斛，小戶一斛，以久困重圍也。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed grain on the common people within Xiangzhou city—two piculs for large households, one for small—because they had long suffered under heavy siege.
translations.idiomatic: An edict bestowed grain on the people within Xiangzhou city—two piculs for large households, one for small—because they had long endured a heavy siege.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以太子賓客趙元輔權判太常卿事，充山陵禮儀使。

translations.literal: On jisi, Crown Prince's Mentor Zhao Yuanfu was appointed acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and made mausoleum ritual commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Crown Prince's Mentor Zhao Yuanfu was appointed acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and named mausoleum ritual commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，葬太皇太后於魏縣秦固村。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Grand Empress Dowager was buried at Qinggu Village in Wei County.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Grand Empress Dowager was buried at Qinggu Village in Wei County.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，契丹遣使致祭於高祖，賻禮御馬二匹、羊千口、絹千匹。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Khitan sent envoys to offer sacrifice to Gaozu, with funeral gifts of two imperial horses, a thousand sheep, and a thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Khitan sent envoys to offer sacrifice to Gaozu, with funeral gifts of two imperial horses, a thousand sheep, and a thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 契丹主母亦遣使來慰。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler's mother also sent envoys with condolences.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler's mother also sent envoys with condolences.

sentences.zh: 詔免襄州城內人戶今年夏秋來屋稅，其城外下營處與放二年租稅。

translations.literal: An edict remitted this year's summer and autumn dwelling taxes for households within Xiangzhou city; for encampments outside the walls, rents and taxes were remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted this year's summer and autumn dwelling taxes for households within Xiangzhou city; for camps outside the walls, rents and taxes were remitted for two years.

sentences.zh: 應被安從進脅從者，一切不問。

translations.literal: All who had been coerced to follow An Congjin were not to be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: All who had been coerced into following An Congjin were not to be prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 是月，河中、河東、河西、徐、晉、商、汝等州蝗。

translations.literal: That month, Hezhong, Hedong, Hexi, Xu, Jin, Shang, Ru, and other prefectures reported locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hezhong, Hedong, Hexi, Xu, Jin, Shang, Ru, and other prefectures reported locusts.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑朔，百官素服臨於天清殿。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day dingchou, the hundred officials in plain dress attended at Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day dingchou, the hundred officials in mourning dress attended at Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，分命朝臣詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On jimao, court ministers were separately ordered to temples and abbeys to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao court ministers were dispatched separately to temples and abbeys to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，兩浙節度使吳越國王錢宏佐、福建節度使王延羲，並加食邑，仍改賜功臣名號。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Liangzhe military commissioner and King of Wuyue Qian Hongzuo and Fujian military commissioner Wang Yanxi were both given increased fief households and newly bestowed merit titles.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Qian Hongzuo, military commissioner of Liangzhe and King of Wuyue, and Wang Yanxi, military commissioner of Fujian, both received enlarged fiefs and newly bestowed merit titles.

sentences.zh: 癸未，帝御乾明門，觀襄州行營都部署高行周、都監張從恩等獻俘馘。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the emperor held court at Qianming Gate to view Xiangzhou campaign overall commander Gao Xingzhou, overseer Zhang Congen, and others presenting captives and severed heads.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the emperor held court at Qianming Gate to view Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the Xiangzhou campaign, overseer Zhang Congen, and others presenting captives and severed heads.

sentences.zh: 有司宣露布訖，以安從進男宏受等四十四人徇於市，皆斬之。

translations.literal: When the relevant offices had proclaimed the victory bulletin, An Congjin's son Hongshou and forty-three others were paraded through the market and all beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: After the relevant offices proclaimed the victory bulletin, An Congjin's son Hongshou and forty-three others were paraded through the market and all beheaded.

sentences.zh: 曲赦京城禁囚。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the capital's detention.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners held in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲申，宴班師將校於崇德殿，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On jiashen, he feasted the returning army's officers at Chongde Hall and bestowed goods in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he feasted the returning army's officers at Chongde Hall and bestowed gifts in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，宰臣和凝上《回河頌》，賜鞍馬器帛。

translations.literal: On yiyou, chief minister He Ning submitted an "Ode on the River's Return" and was bestowed saddle, horse, vessels, and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou chief minister He Ning submitted an "Ode on the River's Return" and received a saddle, horse, vessels, and silks.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以宋州歸德軍節度使安彥威為西京留守兼河南尹；

translations.literal: On dinghai, Guide Army military commissioner of Songzhou An Yanwei was made Western Capital regent and concurrent Henan intendant;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai An Yanwei, military commissioner of the Guide Army at Songzhou, was appointed Western Capital regent and concurrent Henan intendant;

sentences.zh: 以襄州行營都部署、西京留守高行周為宋州節度使，加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Xiangzhou campaign overall commander and Western Capital regent Gao Xingzhou was made Songzhou military commissioner and added as Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the Xiangzhou campaign and Western Capital regent, was made military commissioner of Songzhou and promoted to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，降襄州為防禦使額，均、房二州割屬鄧州，升泌州為團練使額。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Xiangzhou was reduced to a defense command; Jun and Fang prefectures were detached to Dengzhou; Bi prefecture was raised to a training command.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Xiangzhou was reduced to a defense command; Jun and Fang prefectures were reassigned to Dengzhou; and Bi prefecture was raised to a training command.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以東京留守兼開封尹李德充為廣晉尹；

translations.literal: On jichou, Eastern Capital regent and concurrent Kaifeng intendant Li Dechong was made Guangjin intendant;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Li Dechong, Eastern Capital regent and concurrent Kaifeng intendant, was appointed Guangjin intendant;

sentences.zh: 以宣徽南院使、襄州行營都監張從恩為東京留守兼開封尹，加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat commissioner and Xiangzhou campaign overseer Zhang Congen was made Eastern Capital regent and concurrent Kaifeng intendant and added as Grand Marshal;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Congen, Southern Bureau commissioner of the Palace Secretariat and overseer of the Xiangzhou campaign, was appointed Eastern Capital regent and concurrent Kaifeng intendant and promoted to Grand Marshal;

sentences.zh: 以前同州節度使、襄州行營副部署宋彥筠為鄧州威勝軍節度使，加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: Former Tongzhou military commissioner and Xiangzhou campaign deputy overall commander Song Yanjun was made Weisheng Army military commissioner of Dengzhou and added as Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Former Tongzhou military commissioner and deputy overall commander of the Xiangzhou campaign Song Yanjun was appointed military commissioner of the Weisheng Army at Dengzhou and promoted to Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 山陵禮儀使撰高祖祔饗太廟酌獻樂章，上之。

translations.literal: The mausoleum ritual commissioner drafted the libation hymn for Gaozu's enshrinement and joint offering in the Grand Temple and submitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The mausoleum ritual commissioner drafted the libation hymn for Gaozu's enshrinement and joint offering in the Grand Temple and submitted it.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔今後除授留守，宜降麻制。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict ordered that hereafter appointments as regent should issue hemp edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict ordered that future appointments as regent should be announced by hemp edict.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，樂平公主史氏進封魯國大長公主，壽安長公主烏氏進封衛國大長公主，鄭國長公主杜氏進封宋國大長公主。

translations.literal: On guisi, Princess of Leping Lady Shi was advanced to Grand Princess of Lu; Princess of Shou'an Lady Wu to Grand Princess of Wei; Princess of Zheng Lady Du to Grand Princess of Song.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Princess of Leping Lady Shi was advanced to Grand Princess of Lu; Princess of Shou'an Lady Wu to Grand Princess of Wei; and Princess of Zheng Lady Du to Grand Princess of Song.

sentences.zh: 荊南高從誨累表讓尚書令之命。

translations.literal: Gao Conghui of Jingnan repeatedly submitted memorials declining the appointment as Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Conghui of Jingnan repeatedly memorialized the throne, declining the appointment as Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，追封故秦國長公主為梁國長公主，故永壽長公主為岐國大長公主，故延慶長公主為邠國大長公主。

translations.literal: On jihai, the former Princess of Qin was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Liang, the former Princess of Yongshou as Grand Princess of Qi, and the former Princess of Yanqing as Grand Princess of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the court posthumously enfeoffed the former Princess of Qin as Princess of Liang, the former Princess of Yongshou as Grand Princess of Qi, and the former Princess of Yanqing as Grand Princess of Bin.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以義成軍節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞充大行皇帝山陵一行都部署。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Li Shouzhen, military governor of Yicheng Army and concurrent commander of the Palace Mounted Guard, was appointed overall commander of the imperial funeral procession for the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Shouzhen, military governor of Yicheng Army and concurrent commander of the Palace Mounted Guard, was made overall commander of the late emperor's funeral procession.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以宣徽北院使、判三司劉遂清為鄭州防禦使，以澶州防禦使李承福為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On renyin, Liu Suiqing, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and acting commissioner of the Three Department Finance Office, was appointed defender of Zhengzhou; Li Chengfu, defender of Chanzhou, was appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Liu Suiqing, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and acting commissioner of the Three Department Finance Office, was made defender of Zhengzhou, while Li Chengfu, defender of Chanzhou, was appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔大行皇帝十一月十日山陵，宜自十月一日至十一月二十日不坐，放文武百官朝參。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict was issued: the late emperor's burial was set for the tenth day of the eleventh month; from the first day of the tenth month through the twentieth day of the eleventh month the emperor should not hold court, and civil and military officials were excused from attending court.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict fixed the late emperor's burial for the tenth day of the eleventh month and ordered that from the first day of the tenth month through the twentieth day of the eleventh month the emperor would not hold court and civil and military officials were excused from attendance.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上大行皇帝尊謚寶冊，百官素服班於天清殿。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the posthumous title register and imperial seal were presented for the late emperor; officials in white mourning robes lined up in the Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the posthumous title register and imperial seal were presented for the late emperor, and officials in white mourning assembled in ranks at the Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：天福七年，中書門下奏：山陵禮儀使狀：「高祖尊謚號及廟號，伏準故事，將啟殯宮前，擇日命太尉率百僚奉謚冊，告天於圜丘畢，奉謚冊跪讀於靈前。

translations.literal: ("Five Dynasties Institutional Essentials": In Tianfu 7, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: The imperial funeral protocol commissioner reported: "Regarding Gaozu's posthumous title and temple name, following precedent, before opening the coffin chamber a day should be chosen and the Grand Marshal should lead all officials to present the posthumous title register, announce to Heaven at the Round Mound altar, and then kneel and read the register before the spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: ("Five Dynasties Institutional Essentials": In Tianfu 7 the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized that the imperial funeral protocol commissioner had reported: "For Gaozu's posthumous title and temple name, following precedent, before the coffin chamber is opened a day should be chosen and the Grand Marshal should lead all officials to present the posthumous title register, announce to Heaven at the Round Mound altar, and then kneel and read the register before the spirit tablet.

sentences.zh: 」此累朝之制，蓋以天命尊極，不可稽留。

translations.literal: "This has been the practice of successive dynasties, because the mandate of Heaven and supreme honor cannot be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: "This has been the practice of successive dynasties, for the mandate of Heaven and supreme honor cannot be delayed.

sentences.zh: 今所上高祖聖文章武明德孝皇帝尊謚寶冊，伏緣去洛京地遠，寶冊難以往來，當司詳酌，伏請只差官往洛京，奏告南郊太廟。

translations.literal: The posthumous title register and imperial seal now submitted for Gaozu, the Sage Literary Martial Brilliant Virtue Filial Emperor — because Luoyang is far away, it is difficult for the register and seal to travel back and forth. Our office has considered the matter and respectfully requests that only officials be dispatched to Luoyang to report at the Southern Suburban Altar and the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: As for the posthumous title register and imperial seal now submitted for Gaozu, the Sage Literary Martial Brilliant Virtue Filial Emperor, because Luoyang is far away and the register and seal are difficult to transport back and forth, our office has considered the matter and respectfully requests that officials alone be sent to Luoyang to report at the Southern Suburban Altar and the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 其日，中書門下文武百官立班，中書令、侍中升靈座前讀寶冊，行告謚之禮。）〉

translations.literal: On that day, civil and military officials of the Secretariat-Chancellery should take their ranks; the Director and Vice Director of the Secretariat should ascend before the spirit seat to read the register and seal, performing the rite of announcing the posthumous title.")
translations.idiomatic: On that day civil and military officials of the Secretariat-Chancellery should take their ranks, and the Director and Vice Director of the Secretariat should ascend before the spirit seat to read the register and seal and perform the rite of announcing the posthumous title.")

sentences.zh: 禮儀使撰進高祖祔饗太廟酌獻樂章舞名，請以《咸和之舞》為名。

translations.literal: The protocol commissioner drafted and submitted the libation music and dance name for Gaozu's enshrinement and sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, requesting that the dance be named "Dance of Universal Harmony."
translations.idiomatic: The protocol commissioner drafted and submitted the libation music and dance name for Gaozu's enshrinement and sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, requesting that the dance be called "Dance of Universal Harmony."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥朔，百官素服臨於天清殿。

translations.literal: On the first day, xinhai, of the tenth month of winter, officials in white mourning assembled at the Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, xinhai, of the tenth month of winter, officials in white mourning gathered at the Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 襄州利市廟封為順正王，仍令本州修崇廟宇。

translations.literal: The Lishi Temple in Xiangzhou was enfeoffed as King Shunzheng, and the prefecture was ordered to repair and enhance the temple buildings.
translations.idiomatic: The Lishi Temple in Xiangzhou was enfeoffed as King Shunzheng, and the prefecture was ordered to repair and restore the temple buildings.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，啟攢宮，百官衣初喪服入臨。

translations.literal: On guihai, the coffin chamber was opened; officials in the garments of deepest mourning entered to pay respects.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the coffin chamber was opened, and officials in the garments of deepest mourning entered to pay their respects.

sentences.zh: 甲子，靈駕進發，帝於朱鳳門外行遣奠之祭，辭畢還宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the funeral procession set out; the emperor performed the farewell offering rite outside the Zhufeng Gate, and when the rite was complete returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the funeral procession set out; the emperor performed the farewell offering rite outside the Zhufeng Gate and, when the rite was complete, returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太保盧質卒，贈太子太師，謚曰文忠。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Grand Preceptor Lu Zhi died; he was posthumously awarded the title of Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous name Wenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Grand Preceptor Lu Zhi died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Wenzhong.

sentences.zh: 己卯，宰臣李崧母喪，歸葬深州，遣使吊祭之。

translations.literal: On jimao, Chief Councillor Li Song's mother died; he returned to Shenzhou for the funeral, and envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Chief Councillor Li Song's mother died; he returned to Shenzhou for the funeral, and the court dispatched envoys to offer condolences and sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，契丹遣使致祭於高祖，賻馬三匹、衣三襲。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Khitans dispatched envoys to offer sacrifices to Gaozu, presenting three horses and three suits of clothing as funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Khitans sent envoys to offer sacrifices to Gaozu, presenting three horses and three suits of clothing as funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，葬高祖皇帝於顯陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengyin, Emperor Gaozu was buried at Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin, Emperor Gaozu was buried at Xianling.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，湖南奏，前洪州節度使馬希振卒。

translations.literal: On renchen, Hunan reported that Ma Xizhen, former military governor of Hongzhou, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Hunan reported that Ma Xizhen, the former military governor of Hongzhou, had died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔宰臣等分詣寺廟祈雪。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict ordered the chief councillors and others to visit various temples separately to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict ordered the chief councillors and others to visit temples separately to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 庚子，祔高祖神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Gaozu's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Gaozu's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以金吾衛大將軍、權判三司董遇為三司使。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Dong Yu, Grand General of the Gold Crow Guard and acting commissioner of the Three Department Finance Office, was appointed commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Dong Yu, Grand General of the Gold Crow Guard and acting commissioner of the Three Department Finance Office, was appointed commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 詔：「州郡稅鹽，過稅斤七錢，住稅斤十錢，州府鹽院並省司差人勾當。

translations.literal: An edict: "At the prefectures and districts, the salt transit tax shall be seven cash per jin, and the residence tax shall be ten cash per jin; the salt bureaus of the prefectures and the provincial offices shall dispatch personnel to oversee collection.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "At the prefectures and districts, the salt transit tax shall be seven cash per jin and the residence tax ten cash per jin; the salt bureaus of the prefectures and the provincial offices shall dispatch personnel to oversee collection.

sentences.zh: 」先是，諸州府除蠶鹽外，每年海鹽界分約收鹽價錢一千七萬貫，高祖以所在禁法，抵犯者眾，遂開鹽禁，許通商，令州郡配征人戶食鹽錢，上戶千文，下戶二百，分為五等，時亦便之。

translations.literal: "Previously, apart from silkworm salt, the various prefectures annually collected approximately seventeen million strings in salt-price revenue within the sea-salt regions. Because the prohibition laws were widely violated wherever they applied, Gaozu opened the salt monopoly, permitted trade, and ordered prefectures and districts to levy a household salt fee — one thousand cash for upper households, two hundred for lower households, divided into five grades — a measure that was convenient at the time.
translations.idiomatic: "Previously, apart from silkworm salt, the various prefectures annually collected roughly seventeen million strings in salt-price revenue within the sea-salt regions. Because prohibition laws were widely violated, Gaozu lifted the salt monopoly, permitted trade, and ordered prefectures and districts to levy a household salt fee of one thousand cash for upper households and two hundred for lower households, divided into five grades — a measure that was convenient at the time.

sentences.zh: 至是掌賦者欲增財利，難於驟變前法，乃重其關市之征，蓋欲絕其興販歸利於官也。

translations.literal: At this time those in charge of revenue wished to increase profits; finding it difficult to change the previous law abruptly, they increased transit and market taxes — intending to cut off private trade and divert profit to the government.
translations.idiomatic: At this time those in charge of revenue wished to increase profits; unable to change the previous law abruptly, they raised transit and market taxes, intending to cut off private trade and divert the profit to the government.

sentences.zh: 其後鹽禁如故，鹽錢亦征，至今為弊焉。

translations.literal: Thereafter the salt prohibition remained as before, and the salt levy was still collected — a burden that persists to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the salt prohibition remained in force and the salt levy was still collected — a burden that persists to this day.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔：「天地宗廟社稷及諸祠祭等，訪聞所司承管，多不精潔。

translations.literal: On the same day, an edict: "At the altars of Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the altars of Soil and Grain, and all other sacrificial sites, it has been reported that the offices in charge are often negligent in maintaining cleanliness.
translations.idiomatic: On the same day an edict declared: "At the altars of Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the altars of Soil and Grain, and all other sacrificial sites, it has been reported that the offices in charge are often negligent in keeping them clean.

sentences.zh: 宜令三司預支一年禮料物色，於太廟置庫收貯。

translations.literal: The Three Departments should advance one year's worth of sacrificial supplies and store them in a warehouse set up in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments should advance one year's worth of sacrificial supplies and store them in a warehouse established in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 差宗正丞主掌，委監察使監當，祭器祭服等未備者修制。

translations.literal: A director of the Court of Imperial Clan Affairs should be assigned to manage the store; censorate commissioners should supervise; ritual vessels and robes that are missing should be made.
translations.idiomatic: A director of the Court of Imperial Clan Affairs should be assigned to manage it, censorate commissioners should supervise, and missing ritual vessels and robes should be made.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：敕差宗正丞石載仁專主掌，監察御史宋彥升監庫，兼差供奉官陳審璘往洛京，於太廟內隱便處修蓋庫屋五間，俟畢日，催促所支物色，監送入庫交付訖，取收領文狀歸閣。

translations.literal: ("Five Dynasties Institutional Essentials": By imperial order, Director of Imperial Clan Affairs Shi Zairen was specially assigned to manage the store; Censor Song Yansheng was assigned to supervise the warehouse; Attendant Official Chen Shenlin was also dispatched to Luoyang to build five warehouse rooms at a discreet location within the Imperial Ancestral Temple. When construction was complete, the supplied goods were to be urged forward, escorted into the warehouse and delivered, and receipts brought back to court.
translations.idiomatic: ("Five Dynasties Institutional Essentials": By imperial order, Director of Imperial Clan Affairs Shi Zairen was specially assigned to manage the store, Censor Song Yansheng to supervise the warehouse, and Attendant Official Chen Shenlin was also sent to Luoyang to build five warehouse rooms at a discreet location within the Imperial Ancestral Temple. When construction was complete, the supplied goods were to be expedited, escorted into the warehouse and delivered, and receipts brought back to court.

sentences.zh: 每有祠祭，諸司各請禮料。

translations.literal: Whenever there was a sacrifice, each office requested its own ritual supplies separately.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever there was a sacrifice, each office requested its ritual supplies separately.

sentences.zh: 至時委監庫御史宋彥升、宗正丞石載仁旋行給付。

translations.literal: At the time of the ceremony, Censor Song Yansheng, supervisor of the warehouse, and Director Shi Zairen were to distribute them promptly.
translations.idiomatic: At the time of the ceremony, Censor Song Yansheng, supervisor of the warehouse, and Director Shi Zairen were to distribute them at once.

sentences.zh: 其大祠、中祠兼令監察御史檢點，小祠即令行事官檢點。

translations.literal: For major and intermediate sacrifices, censorate commissioners were also to inspect; for minor sacrifices, the officiating officials were to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: For major and intermediate sacrifices, censorate commissioners were also to inspect; for minor sacrifices, the officiating officials were to inspect.

sentences.zh: 如致慢易，本司準格科罪。

translations.literal: In case of negligence or disrespect, the responsible office would punish according to statute.
translations.idiomatic: In cases of negligence or disrespect, the responsible office would punish according to statute.

sentences.zh: 其祭器未有者修制，已有者更仰整飭。）〉

translations.literal: Ritual vessels not yet obtained should be made; those already on hand should be properly maintained.")
translations.idiomatic: Ritual vessels not yet obtained should be made, and those already on hand should be properly maintained.")

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，以威武軍節度副使、充福建管內諸軍都指揮使王亞澄為威武軍副大使，知節度事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, Wang Yacheng, deputy military governor of Weiwu Army and commander of all forces within Fujian, was appointed deputy commissioner of Weiwu Army with authority over military governorship affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, Wang Yacheng, deputy military governor of Weiwu Army and commander of all forces within Fujian, was appointed deputy commissioner of Weiwu Army with charge of military governorship affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔：「諸道州府，每遇大祭祀、冬至、寒食、立春、立夏、雨雪未晴，不得行極刑。

translations.literal: An edict: "In all circuits and prefectures, whenever there are major sacrifices, the winter solstice, the Cold Food Festival, the start of spring, the start of summer, or while rain or snow has not yet cleared, capital punishment must not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "In all circuits and prefectures, whenever there are major sacrifices, the winter solstice, the Cold Food Festival, the start of spring, the start of summer, or while rain or snow has not yet cleared, capital punishment must not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 如有已斷下文案，可取次日及雨雪定後施行。

translations.literal: If cases have already received final judgment, execution may take place the following day or after the weather has cleared."
translations.idiomatic: If cases have already received final judgment, execution may take place the following day or after the weather has cleared."

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，以前鄧州節度使安審暉為左羽林統軍，以前延州節度使丁審琪為右羽林統軍，以前金州節度使潘環為左神武統軍，以前華州節度使皇甫立為左金吾衛上將軍，以右龍武統軍劉遂凝為左驍衛上將軍，以前貝州節度使馬萬為右驍衛上將軍，以左龍武大將軍張彥澤為右武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On yichou, An Shenhui, former military governor of Dengzhou, was appointed commander of the Left Feathered Forest Guard; Ding Shenqi, former military governor of Yanzhou, as commander of the Right Feathered Forest Guard; Pan Huan, former military governor of Jinzhou, as commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Huangfu Li, former military governor of Huazhou, as senior general of the Left Gold Crow Guard; Liu Suining, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard, as senior general of the Left Ferocious Guard; Ma Wan, former military governor of Beizhou, as senior general of the Right Ferocious Guard; and Zhang Yanze, grand general of the Left Dragon Martial Guard, as senior general of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou An Shenhui, former military governor of Dengzhou, was made commander of the Left Feathered Forest Guard; Ding Shenqi, former military governor of Yanzhou, commander of the Right Feathered Forest Guard; Pan Huan, former military governor of Jinzhou, commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Huangfu Li, former military governor of Huazhou, senior general of the Left Gold Crow Guard; Liu Suining, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard, senior general of the Left Ferocious Guard; Ma Wan, former military governor of Beizhou, senior general of the Right Ferocious Guard; and Zhang Yanze, grand general of the Left Dragon Martial Guard, senior general of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宰臣馮道、滑州節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞、河陽節度使皇甫遇、西京留守安彥威、廣晉尹李德充，並加爵邑，以山陵充奉之勞也。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Chief Councillor Feng Dao, Li Shouzhen (military governor of Huazhou and concurrent commander of the Palace Mounted Guard), Huangfu Yu (military governor of Heyang), An Yanwei (Western Capital intendant), and Li Dechong (Guangjin intendant) were all granted additional titles and fiefs for their labors in conducting the imperial burial.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Chief Councillor Feng Dao, Li Shouzhen, military governor of Huazhou and concurrent commander of the Palace Mounted Guard, Huangfu Yu, military governor of Heyang, An Yanwei, Western Capital intendant, and Li Dechong, Guangjin intendant, were all granted additional titles and fiefs for their labors in conducting the imperial burial.

sentences.zh: 己巳，回鶻進奉使密裏等各授懷化歸德大將軍、將軍郎將，放還蕃。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Uighur tribute envoys, including Mili and others, were each granted the titles of Great General of Cherishing Transformation and Returning Virtue, or General and Commandant, and released to return to their homeland.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Uighur tribute envoys, including Mili and others, were each granted the titles of Great General of Cherishing Transformation and Returning Virtue, or General and Commandant, and released to return to their homeland.

sentences.zh: 庚午，故洪州節度使馬希振追封齊國公。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Ma Xizhen, the late military governor of Hongzhou, was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Ma Xizhen, the late military governor of Hongzhou, was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 辛未，故中吳建武等軍節度使、彭城郡王錢元尞追封廣陵郡王。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Qian Yuanliao, the late military governor of Zhongwu and Jianwu Armies and Prince of Pengcheng, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Qian Yuanliao, the late military governor of Zhongwu and Jianwu Armies and Prince of Pengcheng, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 丙子，于闐、回鶻皆遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Khotan and the Uighurs both dispatched envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Khotan and the Uighurs both sent envoys presenting local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 天福八年春正月辛巳，盜發唐坤陵，莊宗母曹太后之陵也。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, xinsi of Tianfu 8, thieves broke into Tang's Kunling — the tomb of Empress Dowager Cao, mother of Zhuangzong.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on xinsi of Tianfu 8, thieves broke into Tang's Kunling — the tomb of Empress Dowager Cao, mother of Zhuangzong.

sentences.zh: 河南府上言：「逃戶凡五千三百八十七，餓死者兼之。

translations.literal: The Henan Prefecture reported: "There are 5,387 fleeing households in all, including those who died of starvation."
translations.idiomatic: The Henan Prefecture reported: "There are 5,387 fleeing households in all, including those who died of starvation."

sentences.zh: 」詔：「諸道以廩粟賑饑民，民有積粟者，均分借便，以濟貧民。

translations.literal: An edict: "All circuits should use granary grain to relieve famine victims; households with stored grain should share it by equal distribution as loans to aid the poor."
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered: "All circuits should use granary grain to relieve famine victims; households with stored grain should share it equally as loans to aid the poor."

sentences.zh: 」時州郡蝗旱，百姓流亡，餓死者千萬計。

translations.literal: At the time, locusts and drought afflicted the prefectures and districts; common people fled their homes, and those who died of starvation numbered in the tens of millions.
translations.idiomatic: At the time locusts and drought afflicted the prefectures and districts; common people fled their homes, and those who died of starvation numbered in the millions.

sentences.zh: 東都人士僧道，請車駕復幸東京。

translations.literal: Gentry, monks, and Taoist priests of the Eastern Capital petitioned for the imperial procession to visit the Eastern Capital again.
translations.idiomatic: Gentry, monks, and Taoist priests of the Eastern Capital petitioned for the imperial procession to visit the Eastern Capital again.

sentences.zh: 後唐莊宗德妃伊氏自契丹遣使貢馬。

translations.literal: Lady Yi, Virtuous Consort of Later Tang's Zhuangzong, sent envoys from the Khitans presenting horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yi, Virtuous Consort of Later Tang's Zhuangzong, sent envoys from among the Khitans presenting horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，沙州留後曹元深加檢校太傅，充沙州歸義軍節度使。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Cao Yuanshen, acting prefect of Shazhou, was additionally appointed Honorary Grand Mentor and confirmed as military governor of the Guiyi Army at Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Cao Yuanshen, acting prefect of Shazhou, was additionally appointed Honorary Grand Mentor and confirmed as military governor of the Guiyi Army at Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，發禁軍萬人並家口赴東京。

translations.literal: On guisi, ten thousand men of the palace guard army together with their families were dispatched to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi ten thousand men of the palace guard army, together with their families, were dispatched to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，于闐、回鶻入朝使劉再成等並授懷化大將軍、將軍郎將，放還蕃。

translations.literal: On yisi, Liu Zaicheng and other envoys from Khotan and the Uighurs who had come to court were all granted titles of Great General of Cherishing Transformation or General and Commandant, and released to return to their homeland.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Liu Zaicheng and other envoys from Khotan and the Uighurs who had come to court were all granted the titles of Great General of Cherishing Transformation or General and Commandant, and released to return to their homeland.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，御劄取今月十一日車駕還東京，沿路州府，不用修飾行宮；

translations.literal: On gengxu in the second month, an imperial rescript set the eleventh day of that month for the imperial procession to return to the Eastern Capital; prefectures along the route need not renovate temporary palaces;
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the second month, an imperial rescript set the eleventh day of that month for the imperial procession to return to the Eastern Capital; prefectures along the route need not renovate temporary palaces;

sentences.zh: 食宿頓遞，並以官物供給；

translations.literal: food, lodging, and relay stations would all be supplied with government goods;
translations.idiomatic: food, lodging, and relay stations would all be supplied with government goods;

sentences.zh: 文武臣僚除有公事合隨駕外，並先次進發。

translations.literal: civil and military officials, except those with official business requiring them to accompany the procession, should all set out in advance.
translations.idiomatic: civil and military officials, except those with official business requiring them to accompany the procession, should all set out in advance.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛親軍使景延廣充御營使。

translations.literal: Jing Yanguang, commissioner of the Palace Guard Army, was appointed imperial camp commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yanguang, commissioner of the Palace Guard Army, was appointed imperial camp commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以廣晉尹李德充權鄴都留守。

translations.literal: On guichou, Li Dechong, Guangjin intendant, was appointed acting Ye capital intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Li Dechong, Guangjin intendant, was appointed acting Ye capital intendant.

sentences.zh: 己未，車駕發鄴都，曲赦都下禁囚。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the imperial procession departed the Ye capital; a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners under detention in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the imperial procession departed the Ye capital, and a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners under detention in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次封丘，文武百官見於行宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi, stopping at Fengqiu, civil and military officials were received at the temporary palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, stopping at Fengqiu, civil and military officials were received at the temporary palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，至東京。

translations.literal: On yichou, the procession arrived at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the procession arrived at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以東京留守張從恩為權鄴都留守，以皇弟檢校司徒重睿為檢校太保、開封尹，年幼未出閣，差左散騎常侍邊蔚知府事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Zhang Cong'en, Eastern Capital intendant, was appointed acting Ye capital intendant; the emperor's younger brother, Honorary Palace Steward Chongrui, was appointed Honorary Grand Guardian and Kaifeng intendant; as he was young and had not yet come of age, Left Regular Attendant Bian Wei was assigned to handle prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhang Cong'en, Eastern Capital intendant, was appointed acting Ye capital intendant; the emperor's younger brother, Honorary Palace Steward Chongrui, was made Honorary Grand Guardian and Kaifeng intendant; as he was young and had not yet come of age, Left Regular Attendant Bian Wei was assigned to handle prefecture affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前太僕卿薛仁謙為衛尉卿。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Xue Renqian, former minister of the Stud, was appointed minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Xue Renqian, former minister of the Stud, was appointed minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 河中逃戶凡七千七百五十九。

translations.literal: In Hezhong there were 7,759 fleeing households in all.
translations.idiomatic: In Hezhong there were 7,759 fleeing households in all.

sentences.zh: 是時天下饑，谷價翔踴，人多餓殍。

translations.literal: At this time famine gripped the realm; grain prices soared, and many people died by starvation.
translations.idiomatic: At this time famine gripped the realm; grain prices soared, and many people died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 右金吾衛上將軍劉處讓卒，贈太尉。

translations.literal: Liu Churang, senior general of the Right Gold Crow Guard, died; he was posthumously awarded the title of Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Churang, senior general of the Right Gold Crow Guard, died; he was posthumously made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯朔，以中書令、監修國史趙瑩為晉昌軍節度使，以晉昌軍節度使桑維翰為侍中、監修國史。

translations.literal: On the first day, jimao, of the third month, Zhao Ying, Director of the Secretariat and supervisor of the National History, was appointed military governor of Jinchang Army; Sang Weihan, military governor of Jinchang Army, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and supervisor of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, jimao, of the third month, Zhao Ying, Director of the Secretariat and supervisor of the National History, was appointed military governor of Jinchang Army, and Sang Weihan, military governor of Jinchang Army, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and supervisor of the National History.

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》作晉昌節度使、兼侍中桑維翰為侍中。

translations.literal: ("Comprehensive Mirror" reads: "Sang Weihan, military governor of Jinchang and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, [was appointed] Vice Director of the Secretariat.")
translations.idiomatic: ("Comprehensive Mirror" reads: "Sang Weihan, military governor of Jinchang and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, [was appointed] Vice Director of the Secretariat.")

sentences.zh: 胡三省註云：桑維翰始居藩鎮而兼侍中，今入朝，正為門下省長官。）〉

translations.literal: Hu Sanxing's commentary says: Sang Weihan had originally held a regional post while concurrently serving as Vice Director of the Secretariat; now that he had entered court, he was formally made chief of the Department of the Chancellery.")
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sanxing's commentary says: Sang Weihan had originally held a regional post while concurrently serving as Vice Director of the Secretariat; now that he had entered court, he was formally made chief of the Department of the Chancellery.")

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以左散騎常侍盧重為秘書監，以東京副留守羅周嶽為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Lu Chong, Left Regular Attendant, was appointed director of the Palace Library; Luo Zhouyue, deputy Eastern Capital intendant, was appointed Right Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Lu Chong, Left Regular Attendant, was appointed director of the Palace Library, and Luo Zhouyue, deputy Eastern Capital intendant, was made Right Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 癸未，青州節度使、東平王楊光遠進封壽王，北京留守劉知遠、恒州節度使杜威並加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On guimwei, Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Qingzhou and Prince of Dongping, was advanced to Prince of Shou; Liu Zhiyuan, Northern Capital intendant, and Du Wei, military governor of Hengzhou, were both additionally appointed concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guimwei Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Qingzhou and Prince of Dongping, was advanced to Prince of Shou; Liu Zhiyuan, Northern Capital intendant, and Du Wei, military governor of Hengzhou, were both additionally made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以鄜州節度使符彥卿為河陽節度使，以權鄴都留守、前開封尹張從恩為鄴都留守、廣晉尹，以右羽林統軍丁審琪為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Fu Yanqing, military governor of Fuzhou, was appointed military governor of Heyang; Zhang Cong'en, acting Ye capital intendant and former Kaifeng intendant, was appointed Ye capital intendant and Guangjin intendant; Ding Shenqi, commander of the Right Feathered Forest Guard, was appointed military governor of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Fu Yanqing, military governor of Fuzhou, was made military governor of Heyang; Zhang Cong'en, acting Ye capital intendant and former Kaifeng intendant, was appointed Ye capital intendant and Guangjin intendant; and Ding Shenqi, commander of the Right Feathered Forest Guard, was made military governor of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，天策上將軍、湖南節度使、楚王馬希範加守尚書令、兼中書令。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Ma Xifan, Grand General of the Heavenly Strategy, military governor of Hunan, and King of Chu, was additionally appointed Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Ma Xifan, Grand General of the Heavenly Strategy, military governor of Hunan, and King of Chu, was additionally appointed Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己丑，桂州節度使馬希杲依前檢校太尉、兼侍中，兼知朗州軍州事；

translations.literal: On jichou, Ma Xigao, military governor of Guizhou, retained his previous Honorary Grand Marshal and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat posts and was additionally given charge of Langzhou military and civil affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Ma Xigao, military governor of Guizhou, retained his previous Honorary Grand Marshal and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat posts and was additionally given charge of Langzhou military and civil affairs;

sentences.zh: 朗州武平軍節度使馬希萼加檢校太尉，進封爵邑。

translations.literal: Ma Xi'e, military governor of Wuping Army at Langzhou, was additionally appointed Honorary Grand Marshal and granted an advance in title and fief.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xi'e, military governor of Wuping Army at Langzhou, was additionally appointed Honorary Grand Marshal and granted an advance in title and fief.

sentences.zh: 以武平軍節度副使、岳州團練使馬希瞻為檢校太尉，領盧州昭信軍節度使；

translations.literal: Ma Xizhan, deputy military governor of Wuping Army and prefect of Yuezhou, was appointed Honorary Grand Marshal and military governor of Zhaoxin Army at Luzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xizhan, deputy military governor of Wuping Army and prefect of Yuezhou, was appointed Honorary Grand Marshal and military governor of Zhaoxin Army at Luzhou;

sentences.zh: 以武安軍節度副使、永州團練使馬希廣為檢校太尉，領洪州鎮南軍節度使；

translations.literal: Ma Xiguang, deputy military governor of Wu'an Army and prefect of Yongzhou, was appointed Honorary Grand Marshal and military governor of Zhennan Army at Hongzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiguang, deputy military governor of Wu'an Army and prefect of Yongzhou, was appointed Honorary Grand Marshal and military governor of Zhennan Army at Hongzhou;

sentences.zh: 皆楚王馬希範之弟也。

translations.literal: All were younger brothers of Ma Xifan, King of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: All were younger brothers of Ma Xifan, King of Chu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以宣徽北院使李承福為右武衛大將軍，充宣徽南院使；

translations.literal: On gengyin, Li Chengfu, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed grand general of the Right Martial Guard and commissioned as commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Chengfu, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made grand general of the Right Martial Guard and commissioned as commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以前鄭州防禦使劉繼勛為左千牛衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: Liu Jixun, former defender of Zhengzhou, was appointed grand general of the Left Office of the Thousand-Ox Guard and commissioned as commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jixun, former defender of Zhengzhou, was made grand general of the Left Office of the Thousand-Ox Guard and commissioned as commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 國子祭酒兼戶部侍郎田敏以印本《五經》書上進，賜帛五十段。

translations.literal: Tian Min, Chancellor of the National University and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue, presented printed copies of the Five Classics; he was granted fifty bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min, Chancellor of the National University and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue, presented printed copies of the Five Classics and was granted fifty bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 甲午，有白烏棲作坊桐樹，作坊使周務掠捕而進之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, a white crow perched in a paulownia tree at the workshops; Workshop Commissioner Zhou Wu captured it and presented it to the court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a white crow perched in a paulownia tree at the workshops; Workshop Commissioner Zhou Wu captured it and presented it to the court.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，引進使、太府卿孟承誨使契丹。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Meng Chenghui, reception commissioner and minister of the Imperial Storehouse, was dispatched as envoy to the Khitans.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Meng Chenghui, reception commissioner and minister of the Imperial Storehouse, was dispatched as envoy to the Khitans.

sentences.zh: 詔京百司攝官親公事及五年，與授初官。

translations.literal: An edict: acting officials in the capital bureaus who had personally handled official business for five years would be granted initial regular appointments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that acting officials in the capital bureaus who had personally handled official business for five years would be granted initial regular appointments.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左諫議大夫司徒詡為給事中，左司郎中王仁裕為右諫議大夫，前鴻臚卿王均為少府監。

translations.literal: On guimao, Situ Xu, Left Remonstrance Counsellor, was appointed Chief of the Palace Secretariat Service; Wang Renyu, director of the Left Bureau of the Secretariat, was appointed Right Remonstrance Counsellor; Wang Jun, former minister of Ceremonial, was appointed director of the Office of Palace Manufactories.
