translations.idiomatic: On guimao Situ Xu, Left Remonstrance Counsellor, was appointed Chief of the Palace Secretariat Service; Wang Renyu, director of the Left Bureau of the Secretariat, was made Right Remonstrance Counsellor; and Wang Jun, former minister of Ceremonial, was appointed director of the Office of Palace Manufactories.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day, wushen, of the fourth month of summer, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, wushen, of the fourth month of summer, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以許州節度使趙在禮為徐州節度使，以徐州節度使李從溫為許州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Zaili, military governor of Xuzhou (Xuchang), was appointed military governor of Xuzhou (Xuzhou); Li Congwen, military governor of Xuzhou (Xuzhou), was appointed military governor of Xuzhou (Xuchang).
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhao Zaili, military governor of Xuchang, was made military governor of Xuzhou, and Li Congwen, military governor of Xuzhou, was made military governor of Xuchang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，中書門下奏：「請以六月二十七日降誕日為啟聖節。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "We request that the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month, the emperor's birthday, be established as Qisheng Festival."
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "We request that the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month, the emperor's birthday, be established as Qisheng Festival."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南、河北、關西諸州旱蝗，分命使臣捕之。

translations.literal: That month, drought and locusts afflicted the various prefectures of Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi; envoys were dispatched separately to conduct extermination campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: That month drought and locusts afflicted the various prefectures of Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi, and envoys were dispatched separately to conduct extermination campaigns.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，追封皇故長姊為吳國長公主。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao, the emperor's deceased elder sister was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, the emperor's deceased elder sister was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Wu.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皇侄女永福縣主薨，輟朝三日，追封平昌郡主。

translations.literal: On guimwei, the emperor's niece, Lady Yongfu County, died; court was suspended for three days; she was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Pingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimwei the emperor's niece, Lady Yongfu County, died; court was suspended for three days, and she was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Pingchang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，皇第二叔祖贈太師萬友追封秦王；

translations.literal: On dinghai, the emperor's second grand-uncle, the late Grand Preceptor Wan You, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qin;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor's second grand-uncle, the late Grand Preceptor Wan You, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qin;

sentences.zh: 皇第三叔祖贈太尉萬銓贈太師，追封趙王。

translations.literal: the emperor's third grand-uncle, the late Grand Marshal Wan Quan, was additionally awarded Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's third grand-uncle, the late Grand Marshal Wan Quan, was additionally made Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 皇伯贈太傅敬儒贈太師，追封宋王；

translations.literal: The emperor's uncle, the late Grand Tutor Jingru, was additionally awarded Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Song;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's uncle, the late Grand Tutor Jingru, was additionally made Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Song;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太尉福王德贈太師，追封如故；

translations.literal: The emperor's uncle, the late Grand Marshal Prince of Fu Wang De, was awarded Grand Preceptor, with posthumous enfeoffment as before;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's uncle, the late Grand Marshal Prince of Fu Wang De, was made Grand Preceptor, with posthumous enfeoffment unchanged;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太傅暉贈太師，追封韓王；

translations.literal: The emperor's uncle, the late Grand Tutor Hui, was awarded Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Han;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's uncle, the late Grand Tutor Hui, was made Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Han;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太尉通王殷、皇叔贈太尉廣王威、皇兄贈太傅郯王重裔並贈太師，追封如故。

translations.literal: The emperor's uncles, the late Grand Marshals Prince of Tong Wang Yin and Prince of Guang Wang Wei, and the emperor's elder brother, the late Grand Tutor Prince of Tan Chongyi, were all awarded Grand Preceptor, with posthumous enfeoffment as before.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's uncles, the late Grand Marshals Prince of Tong Wang Yin and Prince of Guang Wang Wei, and his elder brother, the late Grand Tutor Prince of Tan Chongyi, were all made Grand Preceptor, with posthumous enfeoffment unchanged.

sentences.zh: 皇兄贈太師沂王重信追封楚王；

translations.literal: The emperor's elder brother, the late Grand Preceptor Prince of Yi Chongxin, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's elder brother, the late Grand Preceptor Prince of Yi Chongxin, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu;

sentences.zh: 皇兄贈太傅虢王重乂、皇兄贈太師夔王重進、皇弟贈太尉陳王重杲等並贈太師，追封如故。

translations.literal: The emperor's elder brothers, the late Grand Tutor Prince of Guo Chongyi and Grand Preceptor Prince of Kui Chongjin, and younger brother, the late Grand Marshal Prince of Chen Chonggao, and others were all awarded Grand Preceptor, with posthumous enfeoffment as before.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's elder brothers, the late Grand Tutor Prince of Guo Chongyi and Grand Preceptor Prince of Kui Chongjin, and his younger brother, the late Grand Marshal Prince of Chen Chonggao, and others were all made Grand Preceptor, with posthumous enfeoffment unchanged.

sentences.zh: 仍令所司擇日冊命。

translations.literal: The relevant offices were further ordered to choose a day for investiture by patent.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices were further ordered to choose a day for formal investiture.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以御史中丞王易簡為尚書左丞，以禮部侍郎張允為御史中丞，以中書舍人吳承範為禮部侍郎，以吏部侍郎王延為尚書右丞，以尚書右丞王松為吏部侍郎，以兵部侍郎張昭遠為吏部侍郎，以戶部侍郎呂琦為兵部侍郎，以刑部侍郎韋勛為戶部侍郎，以工部侍郎李詳為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was made Left Director of the Masters of Writing; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yun was made Censor-in-Chief; Secretariat Drafter Wu Chengfan was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yan was made Right Director of the Masters of Writing; Right Director Wang Song was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of Justice Wei Xun was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Vice Minister of Works Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was appointed Left Director of the Masters of Writing; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yun became Censor-in-Chief; Secretariat Drafter Wu Chengfan became Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yan became Right Director of the Masters of Writing; Right Director Wang Song became Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhaoyuan became Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi became Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of Justice Wei Xun became Vice Minister of Revenue; and Vice Minister of Works Li Xiang became Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命宰臣等分詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On guisi, chief ministers and others were ordered separately to temples and abbeys to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi chief ministers and others were dispatched separately to temples and abbeys to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 己亥，飛蝗自北翳天而南。

translations.literal: On jihai, flying locusts from the north darkened the sky as they moved south.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai flying locusts from the north darkened the sky as they moved southward.

sentences.zh: 太子賓客李棁卒。

translations.literal: Crown Prince's Mentor Li Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince's Mentor Li Zhi died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔：「諸道州府見禁罪人，除十惡五逆、行劫殺人、偽行印信、合造毒藥、官典犯贓各減一等外，餘並放。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict declared: "Prisoners currently detained in the circuits and prefectures—except for the ten abominations, the five rebellions, highway robbery and murder, forging seals and credentials, compounding poison, and official embezzlement, each reduced one grade in punishment—all the rest are to be released."
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen an edict declared: "For prisoners currently detained in the circuits and prefectures—except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, highway robbery and murder, forging seals and credentials, compounding poison, and official embezzlement, each of which is reduced one grade in punishment—all others are to be released."

sentences.zh: 」是時所在旱蝗，故有是詔。

translations.literal: At this time drought and locusts prevailed everywhere; hence this edict.
translations.idiomatic: At this time drought and locusts prevailed everywhere; hence this edict.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸相國寺祈雨。

translations.literal: On yisi, he visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，以螟蝗為害，詔侍衛馬步軍都指揮使李守貞往臯門祭告，仍遣諸司使梁進超等七人分往開封府界捕之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengxu, because caterpillars and locusts were causing harm, an edict ordered Palace Guard cavalry-infantry commander Li Shouzhen to go to Gaomen Gate to offer sacrifice and report, and further sent seven bureau commissioners including Liang Jinchao separately into Kaifeng prefecture's jurisdiction to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu, because caterpillars and locusts were causing harm, an edict ordered Palace Guard cavalry-infantry commander Li Shouzhen to offer sacrifice and report at Gaomen Gate, and sent seven bureau commissioners including Liang Jinchao separately into Kaifeng prefecture's jurisdiction to capture them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以左羽林統軍安審暉為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: On yimao, Left Forest Guard commander An Shenhui was made Luzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao An Shenhui, commander of the Left Forest Guard, was appointed military commissioner of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 宿州奏，飛蝗抱草幹死。

translations.literal: Suzhou reported that flying locusts clung to grass and died dry.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou reported that flying locusts clung to the grass and died dried upon it.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，貝州奏，逃戶凡三千七百。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Beizhou reported absconding households totaling three thousand seven hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Beizhou reported three thousand seven hundred absconding households.

sentences.zh: 遣供奉官衛延韜詣嵩山投龍祈雨。

translations.literal: He sent Palace Supply Officer Wei Yantao to Mount Song to cast the dragon and pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Palace Supply Officer Wei Yantao to Mount Song to cast the dragon ritual and pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以西京留守馬從斌為左監門衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Western Capital regent Ma Congbin was made General-in-Chief of the Left Gate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Western Capital regent Ma Congbin was appointed General-in-Chief of the Left Gate Guard.

sentences.zh: 開封府界飛蝗自死。

translations.literal: Within Kaifeng prefecture's jurisdiction, flying locusts died on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Within Kaifeng prefecture's jurisdiction the flying locusts died on their own.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河南府奏，飛蝗大下，遍滿山野，草苗木葉食之皆盡，人多餓死。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Henan prefecture reported that flying locusts descended in great numbers, filling the mountains and wilds; grass, trees, and leaves were all eaten bare, and many people died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Henan prefecture reported that flying locusts descended in vast numbers, filling the mountains and wilds; grass, trees, and foliage were stripped bare, and many people starved to death.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎吳承範卒。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Wu Chengfan died.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Wu Chengfan died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以將冊皇太后，遣尚書左丞王易簡奏告天地。

translations.literal: On bingyin, because the empress dowager was about to be invested by patent, Left Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Yijian was sent to report to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, because the empress dowager was about to be invested, Left Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Yijian was sent to announce the matter to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 陜州奏，蝗飛入界，傷食五稼及竹木之葉，逃戶凡八千一百。

translations.literal: Shanzhou reported that locusts flew into its borders, damaging the five grains and the leaves of bamboo and trees; absconding households totaled eight thousand one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Shanzhou reported that locusts flew into its borders, damaging the five grains and the leaves of bamboo and trees; absconding households totaled eight thousand one hundred.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以給事中符蒙為禮部侍郎，以左諫議大夫裴坦為給事中。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Supervising Secretary Fu Meng was made Vice Minister of Rites; Left Remonstrance Grandee Pei Tan was made Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Supervising Secretary Fu Meng was appointed Vice Minister of Rites, and Left Remonstrance Grandee Pei Tan was appointed Supervising Secretary.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣內外臣僚二十八人分往諸道州府率借粟麥。

translations.literal: On xinwei, twenty-eight civil and military officials within and without the court were dispatched separately to the circuits and prefectures to compel borrowing of grain and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei twenty-eight civil and military officials were dispatched separately to the circuits and prefectures to compel the lending of grain and wheat.

sentences.zh: 時使臣希旨，立法甚峻。

translations.literal: At the time the envoys curried favor and made the regulations extremely harsh.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the envoys curried favor and made the regulations extremely harsh.

sentences.zh: 民間碓硙泥封之、隱其數者皆斃之，由是人不聊生，物情胥怨。

translations.literal: Among the people, mortars and mills that were mud-sealed or whose numbers were concealed were all punished with death; thereby people could not sustain life, and popular sentiment turned to universal resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Among the people, anyone who mud-sealed mortars and mills or concealed their quantities was put to death; people could no longer sustain themselves, and popular resentment spread everywhere.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸州郡大蝗，所至草木皆盡。

translations.literal: That month, great locust plagues struck the prefectures and districts; wherever they went, grass and trees were consumed entirely.
translations.idiomatic: That month great locust plagues struck the prefectures and districts; wherever they went, grass and trees were stripped bare.
